info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Card Cash Withdrawal-spec
info.description: The Card Cash Withdrawal API allows users to initiate cash withdrawal requests using their bank cards. This operation is designed for cardholders wishing to withdraw cash at ATMs or participating locations. It primarily serves customers of the bank, enabling a seamless and efficient cash access experience. By providing a streamlined method to handle withdrawal processes, this API enhances customer satisfaction and operational efficiency within the banking services framework.

post.summary: Initiate a cash withdrawal for a specific card.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a cash withdrawal transaction for the specified card, enhancing the user’s capability to manage card-related cash transactions efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a cash withdrawal operation for the specified card. Ensure that all required parameters are included and properly formatted to facilitate successful transaction processing.

200.description: The operation was completed successfully, and the response includes relevant details of the cash withdrawal.
